say:4:1423119002:0.text: Ironbeard is as rigid as an old dwarf! He can't seem to accept new ideas.
say:4:1423119002:0.source_cn: 这个铁须，年纪轻轻的，思想可真是个老顽固，一点新事物都...

say:5:1423119003:1.text: I showed him some ancient research documents about arcane steel, along with a prototype we made last time. He's still not convinced!
say:5:1423119003:1.source_cn: 我刚才给他看了帝国时期研究魔钢的文件，还有上次注入魔力...

say:6:1423119004:1.text: You could have made these up. I can't just take your word for it.
say:6:1423119004:1.source_cn: 这些东西都有造假的可能。我不可能凭这些就相信你们。

say:7:1423119005:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style> and Hyla, could you both take Ironbeard to the mine and show him how we enchant the celestrites?
say:7:1423119005:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style> and Hyla, could you both take Ironbeard to the mine and show him how we enchant the celestrites?
say:7:1423119005:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style> and Hyla, could you both take Ironbeard to the mine and show him how we enchant the celestrites?

say:8:1423119006:1.text: This should solve your concern, Ironbeard.
say:8:1423119006:1.source_cn: 这样就绝对没有造假的可能了吧。
